name: fallow
description: Runs Fallow (static JS/TS analyzer — dead code, duplication, complexity), classifies findings by type and confidence, and delivers an interactive report where you pick what to clean. Audits the Fallow report (convergence goal + liveness propagation) to catch false-positives the static analysis misses — cron/systemd, HTTP routes, dynamic imports — framed as tool limitations, not code bugs. Cleanup with a safety net (preview + build/test).
